title: processBlock integration for cadence, noise, alignment, CMakeLists
description:
Be the sole PluginProcessor + CMakeLists.txt owner for phase E. Wire CadenceTracker, NoiseFloorEstimator, AlignmentAnalyzer, and FractionalDelay into the processor prepare/process paths and register new DSP/test sources.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/PluginProcessor.h/.cpp phase-D wiring order (key/detector → AttackGuard → FundamentalEstimator → Sustain/Feedback → state machine → gain)
- Source/DSP/CadenceTracker.*, NoiseFloorEstimator.*, AlignmentAnalyzer.*, FractionalDelay.* public APIs from e.1–e.3
- Existing CMakeLists.txt target_sources / test registration patterns from phases A–D
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md sections 11–13 for control flow and latency reporting intent
- Source/ParameterIDs.h for cadence/noise-learn/align parameters if present

PluginProcessor wiring (realtime-safe):
- Members: CadenceTracker, NoiseFloorEstimator, AlignmentAnalyzer, FractionalDelay (key-path delay) plus existing phase D units.
- prepareToPlay: prepare all phase-E units at sample rate / max block; size FractionalDelay for extended ±100 ms capacity if API allows, default operational clamp ±25 ms until calibration/manual override.
- processBlock order (conceptual extension of phase D):
  1) existing key selection/conditioning
  2) FractionalDelay on key path using accepted/manual alignment delay (Audio parameter or AlignmentAnalyzer accepted value)
  3) existing detector → L
  4) AttackGuard / FundamentalEstimator / Sustain / Feedback as already wired
  5) CadenceTracker: feed valid onsets/attacks; combine tau_release_eff with SustainAnalyzer adaptive release via min() (or documented chain) before GainSmoother release use
  6) NoiseFloorEstimator: observe per-band / broadband log-energy with closed/harmonicity/key-active flags; do not auto-apply suggestions
  7) AlignmentAnalyzer: push key+main onset audio into preallocated capture rings only on audio thread; do not run full correlation on audio thread
  8) existing PerformanceStateMachine → gain path
- Expose or call non-realtime hooks for startLearn/applySuggestions and startAlign/acceptAlignment suitable for later editor binding (simple public methods on the processor are enough; no GUI).
- Latency reporting: when negative DI skew requires main-path lookahead or lookahead delay is engaged, setLatencySamples to the exact main-path delay in samples; default mode remains 0. No hidden latency.
- Read APVTS params via ParameterIDs when present; else safe defaults. No editor/GUI work.

CMakeLists.txt (phase-E sole owner):
- Add CadenceTracker.cpp, NoiseFloorEstimator.cpp, AlignmentAnalyzer.cpp, FractionalDelay.cpp to the plugin/library target_sources
- Register tests/CadenceTests.cpp and tests/AlignmentTests.cpp on the existing test executable/target (bodies filled in e.5)
- Additive only — do not restructure unrelated targets

Do NOT implement test bodies (e.5). Do NOT reimplement DSP math inside PluginProcessor beyond calling unit APIs.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: Source/PluginProcessor.h/.cpp construct and prepare CadenceTracker, NoiseFloorEstimator, AlignmentAnalyzer, and FractionalDelay
processBlock applies FractionalDelay on the key path before detector consumption when an alignment delay is set
CadenceTracker effective release constrains adaptive release used by the gain/release path (min with manual/sustain adaptive release)
NoiseFloorEstimator observes levels during process without auto-applying learn suggestions
AlignmentAnalyzer capture/push is wired without running full cross-correlation on the audio thread
Processor latency samples reflect main-path delay used for negative DI skew / lookahead and default to zero when unused
CMakeLists.txt lists CadenceTracker.cpp, NoiseFloorEstimator.cpp, AlignmentAnalyzer.cpp, and FractionalDelay.cpp on the plugin/library target
CMakeLists.txt registers tests/CadenceTests.cpp and tests/AlignmentTests.cpp on the test target
processBlock path performs no heap allocation attributable to this wiring
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify Source/DSP/CadenceTracker.* implementations except via includes/calls
modify Source/DSP/NoiseFloorEstimator.* implementations except via includes/calls
modify Source/DSP/AlignmentAnalyzer.* implementations except via includes/calls
modify Source/DSP/FractionalDelay.* implementations except via includes/calls
implement PluginEditor Performance Timeline or Align/Learn UI

allowed: add member instances and includes for phase E DSP units on PluginProcessor
combine cadence and sustain adaptive release with min() or equivalent documented chain
read existing APVTS parameters by ParameterIDs when available, else temporary defaults
add CMake target_sources entries for phase E DSP units and CadenceTests/AlignmentTests
add thin public learn/align control methods on the processor for later editor binding
forbidden: expand scope into GUI timeline, Noise Fingerprint panel, or multiband crossover
